recipes.name: Strawberry Trifle
ingredients_raw: 1 (5.1 ounce) package instant vanilla pudding mix
1 (9 inch) angel food cake, cut in cubes
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Place pudding mix into a bowl. Add cold milk and whisk together for 2 minutes. Let rest for 5 minutes.

Layer ½ of the cake cubes in a trifle bowl or other glass serving dish. Layer ½ of the pudding, ½ of the bananas, ½ of the strawberries, and ½ of the whipped topping over top. Repeat all layers once more.
Cover trifle and chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Strawberry Trifle
raw_recipe.description: This strawberry trifle is an attractive dessert with beautiful layers of angel food cake, vanilla pudding, bananas, strawberries, and whipped topping.

review.reviewBody: Excellent! I made a few changes after my husband said it was a "little heavy". I used real whipping cream. After whipping and after preparing the pudding according to the box I gently folded the two together. I also used fresh strawberries. I then placed the cubed angel food caked in the bottom, then whip cream and pudding mixture followed by freshly sliced strawberries and continuing for 2 more layers. I topped the last layer of strawberries with freshly whipped lightly sweetened cream and garnished the top with uncut strawberries. I got rave reviews! It was light, simple and a perfect change from heavy desserts! BRAVO!!!

Beautiful finished product! I also made a few changes: I used cheesecake flavored pudding and folded in some Cool Whip to make it a little lighter, and I also sliced fresh strawberries rather than using frozen. Omitted the bananas as well. So I did a layer of angel cake cubes, a layer of sliced fresh strawberries, a layer of the pudding/Cool Whip mixture, and repeated. I like to make trifles the night before so the layers kind of fuse together

This is an awesome recipe. I did make one change tho. I made a package of strawberry jello and when partially set I added that layer right on the cake cubes. It soaks through the cake and adds a lot of extra flavor. And instead of bananas I used fresh blueberries because that's what we prefer. Apart from that, I followed the recipe. Everyone loved it! Thanks for sharing :)

I just made this for a friends birthday party and it turned out fabulous! I took some of the other suggestions and used regular white cake as opposed to angel food cake because it was going to have to sit overnight and I didn't want the cake to become too soggy...I'm really glad I made the substitution because it was perfect! Also I made homemade whipped cream instead of the cool whip, and I folded it directly into the pudding, this have it a lighter texture and made it easier to spread.

I was afraid that it would just taste like fruit on top of pudding, so I made a few slight changes. I mixed vanilla pudding, 1 cup of milk & 1 cup of sour cream and beat until it thickened, then folded in a tub of cool whip (french vanilla flavored). Layered the cake cubes, FRESH strawberries & blueberries, omitted the bananas because they look yuck after a short time, then the "pudding" mixture. Not only was it delicious, but it was beautiful. It was the right amount of sweetness. It only lasted a day!

It's a great recipe, but I had success with the following substitutions. I substituted a pint of heavy whipping cream for the cool whip sweetened to taste (about 2 T sugar) and flavored with 1 tsp vanilla extract...but it would have been better if I had doubled the whip cream layer, it was so yummy! I also used a mix for the angel food cake. I think homemade cake would be even better, but that's my personal bias and the mix worked in a pinch. I used strawberries and blueberries as the fruit layer, unsweetened. People at work raved about it!

I made this for my family for Easter. I made the following modifications and it came out delicious:

Banana pudding instead of Vanilla

Fixed the pudding by emptying the package into a large bowl, added 3 cups of milk and 1 /2 cups of the whipped cream. Whipped together the ingredients 

3 cups of fresh strawberries sliced instead of frozen
Added a handful of blueberries
3 banana instead of 4

Layered according to instructions 

Everyone enjoyed it! Thank you for sharing your recipe.

I love this and made it for the 4th of July. I used a red and blue colored Red Velvet cake and I added some blue berries to achieve the colors that I wanted. I also used a star cookie cutter to make stars out of the cake. Everyone loved it.

YUM YUM YUM!!!!! So I made a few changes but still giving this recipe 5 starts because IT IS SO DELICIOUS! I made angel food cake from a box in a 9x13 pan so it was easy to cut into squares. I used 1 packet of fat free/sugar free vanilla pudding and 1 packet of fat free/sugar free chocolate pudding. I put them in the fridge to chill while the angel food cake was cooking in the oven. (PS instead of using water for the angel food cake, I used skim milk, it gives it such a soft nice consistency!) I used only an 8oz can of cool whip. I mixed half of it with the vanilla pudding only, and used the rest as the last layer of my trifle for a nice presentation! First layer diced up angel food cake, second layer vanilla custard, followed by my fruit (strawberries, blueberries and banana), then start again with angel food cake layer and then CHOCOLATE pudding. Put in the fridge for about 15 minutes. Take it out and spread the remaining half of cool whip, and make it look pretty with strawberries, blueberries and fruit of your choice! **Tip: to make sure your bananas don't turn brown after you dice them, put them in a bowl of orange juice for about 5 minutes before layering them into your cake!

Enjoy, this recipe is AWESOME and very easy to change up according to your liking! =)

I made this for Easter brunch - everyone loved it.

Why 5 stars?
-Delicious
-Great for a crowd
-Easy. I made it the night before and let it set in the fridge

What I changed:
-Made my own whipped cream. Making your own is just so simple and you can add what you want: sugar, sugar substitute, vanilla. Keep it simple, no added garbage like the "whipped topping" you buy at the store has in it.
-I used fresh strawberries and blueberries because they're in season. 
-I sprinkled slivered almonds on top right before serving. The added crunch offers a nice texture


I'll definitely be making this again.

Delicious! Made the following substitutions based on availability: fresh strawberries instead of frozen, 1L of vanilla custard in lieu of pudding (no extra milk added), fresh whipped cream instead of whipped dessert topping. Very easy to put together & has earned a place in the dessert rotation.
This recipe was delicious, I have made it numerous times. I did substitute the instant pudding with cooked pudding and I also used fresh whipped cream in lieu of frozen. Len

Great dessert. I've made at least every 2 weeks since finding it. A hit with everyone. Have made it 3 layers as well. Only suggestion is to drain the strawberries. I cut a few of the large ones. 1st time using.instant pudding.

First, I had to make a gluten free cake which turn out fairly light and not dense. Then I whipped cream and did add a bit to the pudding. It took a while to put together, with cream on the top, but is is delightful and so pretty in my used-once-a-year Trifle Dish. Great recipe.

This is a quick and beautiful dessert when you're short on time but need something elegant to serve. I omitted the bananas and used fresh strawberries rather than frozen. I also used a butter pound cake instead of the angel food cake on accident, but it was a happy accident and will repeat!

I love trifle cakes or ad I’ve called them punch bowl cakes. Great recipe, I made a few changes and it turned out awesome. It’s not summer yet, I really wanted one. So I decided to make it fit Sunday dinner dessert.

Instead of using a packaged Pudding, make yourself some Pastry Cream. Google the recipe or look one up on YouTube. You will find dozens of vids on how to make it. Super simple - egg yolks and flavored milk - and delicious, just takes some prep time beforehand, as the cream needs to cool before use in a recipe like this one. You can add flavorings to it like Vanilla Extract or Almond extract for instance, or any other similar flavor additive. Every cook who likes to make deserts should have Pastry Cream in their repertoire!

Great recipe. Here’s my tweaks. I choose to use strawberries with no sauce. I like how it looks. The store was out of Angel food cake so I used pound cake. And I cut back the sugar to 1/2 cup. Everyone loved it!
